records.name: Spread Shot Retreat
records.effect: Back-jumps while firing a barrage of Ki Blasts; hits can stun.

records.name: Explosive Wave
records.unlock_method: Skill Shop after completing the main story (normal ending)
records.effect: Creates a defensive explosion that knocks the opponent away and can cancel certain Ki attacks.

records.name: Energy Field
records.effect: Deploys a barrier that cancels Ki Waves; holding the input consumes Ki to maintain it.

records.name: Rolling Bullet
records.effect: Ascends while scattering Ki Blasts; projectiles knock opponents back.

notes: The current Ki Blast Evasive category contains 23 entries. Current XV2 documentation explicitly lists Spread Shot Retreat, Energy Field, and Rolling Bullet acquisition and costs. Explosive Wave's Dragon Ball Wiki page explicitly documents the Xenoverse 2 Skill Shop route after the normal-ending main story; because this is a shop route rather than a PQ reward, UF is false.
